when: the group level is asked for

cases.title: weights in any unit give the same link

cases.title: price indices on different bases give the same link

then: it is still 1.06: only price ratios matter

cases.title: an item without an index is priced with its parent
given: a class with two subclasses, one of which has no index
then: the subclass without an index moves with its class
the basket counts as fully covered
the fallback is reported once, from the subclass to its class

cases.title: an item with no index anywhere is left out and reported

then: the link uses the other items alone
the coverage drops to their share
the item is reported with no index used

cases.title: the all-items index is never a fallback
given: an item without an index and an all-items index that moved
then: the item is left out rather than priced with the all-items index

cases.title: chain-linking at December across a weight change
given: two years with different weights and prices that move in December and January
then: December 2025 is 112.0 on the old weights
January 2026 is linked to December 2025 with the new weights (× 1.075)

cases.title: the chain stops where a December or a year's weights are missing
given: prices without December 2025
when: two years are chained, then again without the second year's weights
then: the index ends at November 2025 the first time
January 2026 is missing both times

cases.title: periods limit what is computed
given: prices for two months
when: the chain is asked for January only
then: only January's link is computed

cases.title: annual and monthly rates
given: an index flat at 100 in 2024 that rises by one point a month in 2025
then: the June annual rate is 6.0%
the monthly rate compares with the month before, December for January
an annual rate without the year before is missing

cases.title: the annual average rate compares yearly averages
given: two years of monthly index levels
when: the annual average rate is computed
then: it compares the two years' average levels
it is missing without a full year
it differs from the mean of the twelve annual rates once the year before isn't flat

cases.title: rebasing keeps every rate
given: an index
then: 2025 averages 100
the annual rates are unchanged

cases.title: each year links to its own file's December
given: December 2024 printed on different bases in the 2024 and the 2025 files
when: the years are chained with prices by year
then: 2025 links to the December of its own file
December 2025 is 110, not 55

cases.title: the pricing map prices an item with another code
given: a pricing map that sends one item to its parent and another to a different class
then: each item moves with the index the map names
both are reported as fallbacks

cases.title: the pricing map's drop takes an item out and rescales
given: an item mapped to drop
then: the item is left out and the rest rescaled, with full coverage
without the rule the item would be priced with its parent

cases.title: untouched, the result is the published rate
given: the calculator, opened with nothing changed
then: your rate and the poorest fifth's rate are its published latest annual rate, for its month

cases.title: every starting group gives its published rate

cases.title: an unknown group in the address is ignored
given: an address with `?from=nobody`
then: the starting group is the default, the poorest fifth

cases.title: a slider changes the result; Reset restores it
given: the calculator at the poorest fifth's basket
when: the first category goes up 5 points
then: the other categories are rescaled so the shares still add up to 100%, and a notice says so

Reset brings back the group's rate and every slider

cases.title: each slider says whether it moved
given: the calculator at a starting group's basket, every slider saying it is the group's

cases.title: a new starting group resets the sliders
given: a slider moved away from the group's basket
when: renters are picked as the starting group
then: the result is the renters' published rate

cases.title: spending entered in euros

then: the total and each category's share follow from the amounts

cases.title: a wrong amount is marked and ignored
given: the calculator in euros
when: an amount that isn't a number is typed, then a valid one
then: the wrong amount is marked invalid and counts as nothing
the valid one is accepted and totalled
clearing empties the amounts

cases.title: the chart shows the starting group, then yours
given: the calculator drawn
then: the chart's label names the starting group alone at first
then the group and your basket
